modules.module_title: prepare required raw materials for kolhapuri chappal making

pcs.pc_description: collect raw material like sisal leave, nylon thread, shoe cream, leather, seeds tree, lime stone, red colour flower, etc.
place raw materials at the workplace for making chappal

collect tools like hammer, punches, stamps, knife, cutting machine, sewing machine, star pogar, thodapaekapathi, grinder, kargoti stone, kurpa, aari, rubber powder, wooden sponge, cactus, etc. for chappal making
prepare leather
stitich leather into bag shape using sisal fiber
fill the leather bag with solution of babul and hirda and leave the bag for 18 days
dry the bag under direct sun light for 1 to 2 days over the bed of babul and hirda
cut leather into required shape by cleaning it in clean water
clean the leather using soft brush
deliver remaining raw material to the designated storage locations

modules.module_title: perform the process of making kolhapuri chappal

pcs.pc_description: trim extra edges of leather to shapes
mark the cut piece of leather using stencil of foot shape
hammer the leather using hammer to make it flat and even
stitch the prepared sole of leather using nylon thread and bee wax
cut leather into strip size
hammer the leather strips
attach prepared leather strap on chappal
paste decorative items using adhesive
apply colour solution over prepared chappal as 1st layer
apply mixture of colour and cream over prepared chappal as 2nd layer
apply polish on prepared chappal as 3rd layer and let it dry in sun for 1 hour

modules.module_title: check quality of prepared kolhapuri chappal

pcs.pc_description: inspect the process based on the quality standard parameters to ensure appropriate quality of leather is achieved
ensure leather is cut into required shape
ensure stitching of chappal is done properly
check colouring and polishing is done appropiately
